integrity: Statements and verification concern complex-valued finite signals. Computations test finite instances only; no independent mathematical validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Exact nonzero time support for integers k from 1 through p in Z/(2p)Z only; no classification of all extremizers or values for k>p. The analytic argument uses Tao/Chebotarev prime Fourier uncertainty.
title: Exact-support Fourier uncertainty on even semiprime cycles: a parity law and sharp odd-support jumps
